executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import json,hashlib,re,threading,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_full_government_original_carrier_probe_v1')
proto=json.loads((base/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
targets=[{"period":"2018M10","url":"https://app.www.gov.cn/govdata/gov/201811/27/432453/article.html"},{"period":"2019M12","url":"https://app.www.gov.cn/govdata/gov/202002/03/453868/article.html"},{"period":"2020M12","url":"https://app.www.gov.cn/govdata/gov/202101/27/467459/article.html"},{"period":"2020M12_NBS","url":"https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202302/t20230203_1900985.html"}]
assert not (base/'实际原载体GET账本.jsonl').exists(),'既有实际调用不重发'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def save(name,x):
 p=base/name;assert not p.exists()
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
save('首四实际原载体请求前登记.json',{'at':now(),'targets_from_actual_queries_or_open':targets,'raw_GET_count_before':0,'web_original_reads':4,'NBS_web_internal_error_preserved_first_raw_GET_not_previously_issued':True,'no_authentication':True,'no_stock_labels':True})
lock=threading.Lock();ledger=base/'实际原载体GET账本.jsonl';(base/'sources').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def trace(x):
 with lock:
  with ledger.open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');f.flush()
def fetch(t):
 out={**t,'started_at':now(),'attempt':1,'raw_GET_retries':0}
 trace({'event':'REQUEST_STARTED',**out})
 try:
  r=requests.get(t['url'],timeout=(10,30))
  p=base/'sources'/(t['period']+'.html');p.write_bytes(r.content)
  s=BeautifulSoup(r.content.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser');full=s.get_text('\n',strip=True)
  fp=base/'sources'/(t['period']+'_全文.txt');fp.write_text(full,encoding='utf-8')
  out.update(status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=p.as_posix(),full_text_path=fp.as_posix(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),bytes=len(r.content),status='BROWSER_CHECK_ONLY' if 'Please enable JavaScript and refresh the page.' in full else ('ORIGINAL_FULL_TEXT_CANDIDATE' if r.status_code==200 and '平均回收期' in full and '附注' in full else 'UNKNOWN_NOT_COMPLETE_ORIGINAL'),full_text=full)
  out['all_original_images']=[{'raw_src':i.get('src'),'raw_other_attributes':dict(i.attrs),'absolute_url':urljoin(r.url,i.get('src',''))} for i in s.find_all('img')]
  out['all_original_links']=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'raw_href':a['href'],'absolute_url':urljoin(r.url,a['href'])} for a in s.select('a[href]')]
  out['original_metadata']=[dict(m.attrs) for m in s.select('meta')]
  out['all_original_tables']=[]
  for ti,tb in enumerate([x for x in s.find_all('table') if not x.find('table')]):
   rows=[]
   for tr in tb.find_all('tr'):
    cs=[re.sub(r'\s+','',c.get_text(' ',strip=True)) for c in tr.find_all(['td','th'],recursive=False)]
    if cs:rows.append(cs)
   out['all_original_tables'].append({'leaf_index':ti,'rows':rows})
  out['scripts_with_original_source_route']=[{'src':x.get('src'),'body':x.get_text()[:45000]} for x in s.find_all('script') if x.get('src') or any(y in x.get_text() for y in ['gov.cn','govdata','related','article','ajax','source','发布'])]
 except Exception as e:out.update(status='GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e))
 out['completed_at']=now()
 trace({'event':'REQUEST_FINISHED',**{k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['full_text','all_original_images','all_original_links','original_metadata','all_original_tables','scripts_with_original_source_route']}})
 return out
receipts=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 for future in as_completed([pool.submit(fetch,t) for t in targets]):
  r=future.result();receipts.append(r);print('已读不同原载体',r['period'],r['status'],flush=True)
receipts.sort(key=lambda r:r['period'])
save('首四不同原载体实际取得及所有原表链接.json',{'at':now(),'actual_original_GETs':4,'reports':receipts,'unknowns_not_dropped':True,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_fits':0})
for r in receipts:
 print(json.dumps({'period':r['period'],'status':r['status'],'raw_tables':len(r.get('all_original_tables',[])),'original_images':r.get('all_original_images',[])[:10],'metadata':r.get('original_metadata'),'original_top_text':r.get('full_text','')[:230]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
